subject.title: Feature Request: Cross-platform migration tool (migrate export/import)

question: Should OpenClaw core own an automated same-product archive import/restore command, or should core stay limited to backup export, platform conversion, verification, and manual restore guidance?
rationale: The answer determines CLI namespace, destructive-write policy, archive trust rules, secret/session portability, and whether overlapping backup/plugin work should proceed in core.

options.title: Scope Minimal Native Import
options.body: Define a preview-first core import/export or backup-restore lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, and security tests before implementation.

options.title: Prefer Backup Convert And Manual Restore
options.body: Keep automated restore out of core for now and improve backup output, platform targeting, verification, and user-facing migration docs.

options.title: Route Optional Pieces To Plugins
options.body: Keep core focused on missing APIs while ClawHub or plugin packages own cloud, scheduled, encrypted, or workspace-specific migration flows.

recommendation.title: Scope Minimal Native Import
recommendation.body: Define a preview-first core import/export or backup-restore lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, and security tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history on backup path-safety and already articulated the restore security boundary in the related implementation discussion.
